# Najeeb Digital Hub (NDH)

> Premium digital services bureau and online academy based in Sokoto, Nigeria, serving clients across Nigeria and the diaspora (UK, US, Canada, Europe, UAE).

NDH delivers design, development, content, marketing, media and AI & tech projects through a managed team of Project Managers and vetted talents. NDH Academy runs online certificate, diploma and professional programs with verifiable digital certificates.
